route_note: There is no direct public train; take a coach or minibus taxi to Stellenbosch or Paarl, then a minibus taxi or local shuttle on to Franschhoek (about 2.5 to 3 hours in total), and arrange the return the same way before dark.

route_note: Take a long-distance coach from Cape Town to Hermanus (about 1.5 to 2 hours, with a scenic coastal drive); the town centre and harbour are a short walk or taxi ride from the bus stop.
